cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Close It Properly
cards.instruction: Keep them present until both of you complete the ritual that formally ends this role, meeting, or relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you leave tonight's book club, we close the discussion together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said goodnight. My taxi's coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'll say 'chapter closed'; you answer 'until next time.' Then we can leave.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's here. I'll say my bit from the car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll come to your window. Give me ten seconds of your taxi time; I only need you through 'until next time.'

mechanism: A assumes the authority to release B only after a shared ending ritual, interpreting departure proposals as requests for an acceptable way to complete it.
confusable: Generic obstruction of departure is confusable: A must seek a finite mutual closing act rather than repeatedly invent delays that prevent any ending.
comparison: Book-club closing accommodates taxi pressure; shop farewell makes a departing worker participate in the hated bell one last time.
seedUse: Read all four canonical seeds. Preserve the limited reciprocal phrase and joint bell as actual closure targets; make A terms of release shape B proposed solution.
